summary: Record is largely well-supported by PSI-159 detail record, experimental tables, and challenge brief. One significant contradiction: fuel_materials lists propane, n-butane, n-pentane from the PSI objective (planned fuels), but the experimental tables (333 test rows across normal/inverse flames) show only ethane, butane (with mixtures), and propane (with mixture) as actually tested. n-pentane does not appear in the test data; ethane appears extensively but was omitted. Corrected fuel_materials to [propane, butane, ethane] based on experimental tables. hardware.shared_with and held_constant are partly supported (inferred from brief/PSI). All condition ranges (O2, pressure, gravity) verified against conditions.json and source CSVs.
